rationale: Contingencies are ranked by the maximum branch loading percentage observed in the post-contingency state. The contingency 'out_l12' is ranked highest as it causes the most severe overload (125.7% on branch 'l13'). The contingency 'out_l34' is flagged as an islanding event because the outage of branch 'l34' disconnects bus 'b4' from the rest of the network.
